reference: Supplied historical scan; page geometry levelled to remove scan tilt. Working proportions follow the supplied crop, not a measured original print.
method: Direct visual measurements of headline ink bounds in source PNGs, using threshold/component analysis to aid placement. Native glyph outlines are to be independently fitted into the boxes; no source pixel contours have been converted into paths.
note: No previous overlap score is reused. Current overlays compare new measured layouts against the supplied scan after straightening. Source photograph differs from modern reconstruction.
